name: Split Licensing — Cueframe
html:
Direct licensing, not just royalty-free

Cueframe's direct licensing model means we hold every right to every track in our catalog, including public performance rights. None of our music is tied to a Performance Rights Organization, so there's less paperwork and less legal exposure for you.

Every track is cleared worldwide, permanently, no matter the format, the territory, or how you choose to publish.

"'Royalty-free' and 'fully cleared' are not the same promise, and the difference matters more than people think. A track can call itself royalty-free and still expose you to a claim the moment you publish somewhere new."

Dana Whitfield, Head of Brand Content, Meridian Media

name: About — Loam
html:
Loam looks closely at home, work, style and the ordinary hours between them, and connects a community of people trying to live a little more deliberately, from Lisbon to Kyoto.

Founded in 2014, Loam has grown into a quarterly print magazine sold in over sixty countries, a daily journal online, and a small library of books, all built around the same unhurried idea.

name: FAQ — Loam
html:
FAQs

Which issue will my subscription start with, and how many will I receive?

You'll receive four print issues a year on a rolling publishing schedule. If you subscribe while Issue Forty-Two is on sale, your first issue will be Issue Forty-Three, and Premium and Digital Subscriptions include immediate access to Loam.com.

Do subscriptions auto-renew?

Yes. A Premium or Digital Subscription renews automatically for one year after it is due, unless you contact support to cancel beforehand. Gift subscriptions do not auto-renew.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Write to support at hello@loammag.com with the name and email on your account. We do not offer partial refunds, and your subscription continues until the end of its current term.

Can I track my subscription issues?

Print issues are dispatched by our distributor and sent by standard mail, which is not trackable. Support can estimate a delivery window if you write in.
